name: The Washington Post editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Washington Post Editorial Board Lean Right (1.0, just past Center) after reviews in July and August 2026, with low confidence; it rates the Post's news pages Lean Left. In February 2025 owner Jeff Bezos refocused the opinion section on 'personal liberties and free markets.' Its editorial page (The Post's View) shows no endorsements in DC or Maryland races from Sept. 26 to Oct. 17, 2026, so it is treated as not endorsing this year. No policy statement on local endorsements was found. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/washington-post-editorial-board-media-bias.

name: Washington City Paper
lean_basis: AllSides rates Washington City Paper Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/washington-city-paper-media-bias.

name: Hill Rag / East of the River (Capital Community News)
lean_basis: Not rated. The recorded description says: "Washington DC’s number 1 hyper-local news publisher since 1976". This does not establish a position on the political scale. Source: https://www.capitalcommunitynews.com/about/.

name: League of Women Voters of the District of Columbia (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter that calls itself 'a nonpartisan political organization' (https://lwvdc.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: DC Democratic State Committee
lean_basis: Official party organization. Its nominees are the June primary winners. The committee opposed Initiative 83 in 2024 and sued to block it.

name: DC Republican Party
lean_basis: Official party organization. Chair Patrick Mara announced on June 18, 2026 'the largest candidate slate in decades': nominees in every districtwide race except mayor.

name: DC Statehood Green Party
lean_basis: Official party organization; DC affiliate of the Green Party. Fielded nominees for mayor, delegate, at-large and Wards 1 and 5 in 2026. Its chair, Darryl Moch, is its at-large nominee.

name: DC for Democracy
lean_basis: Its stated mission or political identity includes: "support progressive issues and candidates". Source: https://www.dcfordemocracy.org/mission-and-values.

name: Greater Greater Washington (GGWash) Elections Committee
lean_basis: Urbanist group whose stated mission is 'to advance racial, economic, and environmental justice in land use, transportation, and housing' (https://ggwash.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Metro DC Democratic Socialists of America
lean_basis: Its stated mission or political identity includes: "a chapter of the national Democratic Socialists of America, the largest socialist organization in the United States". Source: https://mdcdsa.org/about-us/.

name: DC Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Business association for the District (https://www.dcchamber.org/about); chambers map to lean_right (business climate, lower regulation and taxes). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: DC Police Union (FOP Metropolitan Police Department Labor Committee)
lean_basis: Police union (FOP Lodge 2) whose own description, 'Representing 3,000 officers, detectives and sergeants of the District of Columbia’s Metropolitan Police Department' (https://www.dcpoliceunion.com/about), uses no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Metropolitan Washington Council, AFL-CIO
lean_basis: Regional AFL-CIO council that says it works 'to advocate, educate, and organize to improve the lives of all working people in our region' (https://www.dclabor.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Sierra Club, DC Chapter
lean_basis: AllSides rates the national Sierra Club Lean Left (think tank/policy group; independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). This is its DC chapter. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/sierra-club-media-bias.

name: Working Families Party (DC)
lean_basis: Minor party that calls itself 'a multiracial party that fights for workers over bosses and people over the powerful' (https://workingfamilies.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Washington Teachers' Union, AFT Local 6
lean_basis: Union for DC Public Schools teachers (AFT Local 6); its site invites teachers to join for 'support, and resources for educators' (https://www.wtulocal6.net/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Ward One Democrats
lean_basis: Official Democratic Party ward committee for Ward 1.
